title: Travel Trip Value for ClearPath Clients Drawing TimeBank Hours
content:
**Travel trip-value schedule.** For a client drawing TimeBank Prepaid Service Hours travel, the value of an onsite date's trip depends on the client's ClearPath Managed IT Services agreement:

- for a client whose active ClearPath agreement charges an onsite trip charge of zero, the trip is zero hours, the agreement covering the travel;
- for a client whose active ClearPath agreement charges an onsite trip charge above zero, the trip is that trip charge divided by the block's rate per block hour, rounded half up to the hundredth of an hour, so that the block bears the agreement's own trip price;
- for a client without an active ClearPath agreement, the trip stays the onsite trip hours of the block's size.

The onsite trip charge is the flat charge per billable onsite visit of the tier the client's active ClearPath agreement is on; the rate per block hour is that of the block's size.

| Client's position | Trip, hypothetical figures |
|---|---|
| active ClearPath agreement, onsite trip charge 0.00 | 0 hours: no travel entry for the date |
| active ClearPath agreement, onsite trip charge 90.00, block rate 150.00 per block hour | 90.00 divided by 150.00, that is 0.60 hours |
| active ClearPath agreement, onsite trip charge 100.00, block rate 165.00 per block hour | 0.6060…, rounded to 0.61 hours |
| no active ClearPath agreement, size with 0.5 onsite trip hours | 0.50 hours |
